clips.title: 英国政局变动 市场早有预期 专家称长期视角更有效
title_lines: 专家称长期视角更有效

subtitles.en: We've been talking a lot about the UK politics this morning, and I wonder if that throws up any thinking around UK assets for you.
subtitles.zh: 今早我们一直在讨论英国政治，我想知道这是否会影响你对英国资产的看法。

subtitles.en: Is there a sort of wait and see dimension to this?
subtitles.zh: 是否存在某种观望态度？

subtitles.en: If we don't know exactly whether UK political story, the physical story goes, around either guilt or stocks or the pound.
subtitles.zh: 如果我们不确定英国政治走向，无论是关于债券、权益资产还是英镑。
en_highlights: guilt or stocks or the pound

subtitles.en: So my perspective on this is that it feels as though it was widely expected that we would have the result that we had overnight.
subtitles.zh: 我的看法是，市场普遍预期昨晚的结果。

subtitles.en: The pound has done, I don't want to say nothing, but very minimal, oriented move overall, yields globally were moving higher in recent months,
subtitles.zh: 英镑变动很小，全球收益率近几个月走高，

subtitles.en: but they are definitely a good distance off of their highs here in the UK.
subtitles.zh: 但英国收益率远未达到高点。
en_highlights: good distance off of their highs

subtitles.en: So it is a bit of an era of fragmentation and political winds of change and things along those lines.
subtitles.zh: 这是一个碎片化、政治变革的时代。

subtitles.en: And I do think that the market is attuned to that and prepared for it.
subtitles.zh: 我认为市场已经适应并为此做好了准备。

subtitles.en: Don't think it should have a huge factor on where one decides to ultimately invest.
subtitles.zh: 这不应成为**决策的主要因素。

subtitles.en: Not even sexually, because you've got JP Morgan talking about, you know, buy utilities because the nationalisation narratives over done
subtitles.zh: 甚至不是性别因素，因为摩根大通建议买入公用事业股，认为国有化叙事过度。

subtitles.en: stay away from housebuilders because you might do a rent freeze.
subtitles.zh: 避开房屋建筑商，因为可能实施租金冻结。

subtitles.en: Do you just not want to bet on policies like that because we just don't know which handyman and we're going to get the brown height, the blareight, the Corbinite?
subtitles.zh: 你是不想押注这类政策吗？因为我们不知道最终是布朗、布莱尔还是科尔宾式的政策。
zh_highlights: 布朗、布莱尔还是科尔宾
en_highlights: brown height, the blareight, the Corbinite

subtitles.en: So I think that focusing on what the private sector is doing on its own merit is typically the best way to invest.
subtitles.zh: 我认为关注私营部门自身的表现通常是**的最佳方式。
en_highlights: focusing on what the private sector is doing

subtitles.en: It's definitely an era of eventful geopolitics, but trying to see through that over the long run is typically what we think is the best type of approach,
subtitles.zh: 这无疑是一个地缘政治事件频发的时代，但从长远来看，穿透这些事件通常是我们认为的最佳方法。
en_highlights: see through that over the long run

subtitles.en: whether it's here in the region globally or otherwise.
subtitles.zh: 无论是在本地区还是全球范围内。
